review_type: independent official-source visual review; no model generation or mesh certification performed by this reviewer
identity_findings: Officially named 西子樓校友會館 at 高雄市鼓山區蓮海路16號.
Official page calls it a white three-storey building, with 2F and 3F terraces.
2011 renovation retained major beams/columns, then reconstructed walls and additional spaces. NSYSU sign mounted 2012-11-10.
This source does not identify 西子樓 as 逸仙館.

pdf_metadata.interpretation: PDF creation/modification metadata only; not a survey, photography or publication date. No external metre elevation dimensions found.

viewed.own_download_rendering: All four PDF pages rendered at 150dpi using Poppler pdftoppm and actually viewed, plus entire triptych.
viewed.parent_reference_rendering: Actually viewed reference-private/plan-1.png through plan-4.png at 1800px width and xizi-official-photos.png, then enhanced crops to clarify line boundaries.

photo_panels.features: Three storeys, white flat-roof volumes, taller glass corner tower at junction, connected volumes and open terraces; frontage seen obliquely from street.
photo_panels.limits: Trees/angle obscure base and rear; photo date unknown.

photo_panels.features: Open deep terrace, upper balcony slab, glass railing and slender supporting posts; solid rear wall and NSYSU band.
photo_panels.limits: Shows terrace-facing facade only; no precise heights or hidden room extents.

photo_panels.features: View from terrace confirms open underside beneath balcony, several posts and glass guard; glass tower partly at left edge.
photo_panels.limits: Perspective does not establish metric dimensions or all roof faces.

coordinate_system.warning: Manual representative traces of visible lines; do not treat room vertices as precise measurement. Page registrations are approximate and local.

page2_to_page3.note: A +10 y shift aligns main lower edge approximately but displaces this stable stair core by 10px. Keep the residual visible.

page1_to_page2.anchors: Main rectangular lower stair and central stair core; 1F core x714..859 versus 2F x790..937, same y560..694.
page1_to_page2.note: Diamond/tower needs roughly 80..85px rather than 76px. Do not claim all outlines exactly register.

page1_to_page3_model_simplification.note: Acceptable chosen representative alignment of main staircase x717 to835. Glass tower alignment is roughly +126px; residual about8px must be disclosed.

inconsistencies: 2F room north edge y653 versus 3F y695 (41..42px retreat, with stable stair at y560..693).
2F main rectangular bottom y988 versus 3F y1001: 13px local boundary difference persists after stair registration.
2F rectangular terrace far edge y211 versus 3F y334: about123px more outward extension at 2F.
1F and 2F diagonal corner/tower traces do not share the exact x translation of their main rectangular core.

geometry_interpretation.massing: A horizontal rectangular wing and a connected diagonally oriented wing; keep their junction and the stepped terraces. Three above-ground levels plus taller glass corner mass.
geometry_interpretation.rectangular_terraces: Both areas labelled 陽台 on 2F are open terrace areas. The inner dashed contour is not a room enclosure. On 3F the room retreats toward image-bottom, leaving a broad terrace to image-top with stepped outer edge.
geometry_interpretation.angled_terraces: 2F has a smaller open end terrace beyond a room boundary approximately (1168,389) to (1390,604). 3F room retreats to boundary approximately (1152,611) to (1310,743), leaving a much deeper open terrace beyond it, wrapping around the glass diamond.
geometry_interpretation.photo_plan_orientation: Use relative wing labels. The whole-building street view shows rectangular mass extending to photo-left of the glass junction and a connected receding mass toward photo-right. The other two panels are terrace-facing views of the connected complex. No compass/north arrow is available, and precise cardinal facade assignments are unverified.
geometry_interpretation.tower_height: Photo-only estimate: tower projects above the adjacent flat roof by roughly 0.4..0.6 of a storey; not a measured height. Model height must be labelled approximate.
geometry_interpretation.printing_abstraction: Terrace decks may be thickened, glass represented solid, guards/posts simplified or omitted; preserve open volume above decks. Do not extrude the entire plan silhouette as enclosed rooms.
